user.title: Set up HA Forensic Lab
user.description: Create a local, admin-only forensic workspace for Home Assistant.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one HA Forensic Lab instance can be configured.

init.title: Capture and retention
init.description: Control how much normalized forensic evidence is retained. Excluded events are dropped before rolling persistence.

data_description.capture_buffer_size: Maximum normalized events held in the rolling buffer (256–8192).
data_description.persist_interval_seconds: Maximum delay before a dirty rolling snapshot is written (5–60 seconds).
data_description.capture_event_kinds: Only selected runtime event types enter the forensic buffer.
data_description.excluded_entities: Events for these entities are discarded before retention and persistence.
data_description.excluded_domains: Type a Home Assistant domain such as camera or person. Matching events and service targets are discarded before persistence.
